_about: End state of the T-053 / T-054 recorded runs, per category (11 Oct 2026, lane b-85). Runs and abstains are counted by hand from the T-053 lane's labels.json (twenty questions; four abstentions: one certification request on the ask path, three fan-outs) and T-054's gate 3 (a brief is one model call, none with AI off). model_calls are pins taken from the first recorded run, not an independent source: they turn red on any change in how many calls a path makes.
